name: Shutterspeed
storyline:
It's a race against time to save the world from a rogue AI!

After being unconscious for what felt like forever, Shutterspeed wakes up and finds himself not just in a virtual world but one in an entire network created by the Intelligence Control Committee(ICC for short), an institute designed to regulate artificial intelligence and keep humans in control.

He’s only been given one objective… to defeat the guardians of each virtual world, only then will he be strong enough to escape to the real world and destroy the evil AI Heatbones before it conquers earth and beyond.

But Shutterspeed not only has no idea how he got there, he also has no memories of his past. He must learn who he really is and what these trials are really about, but he’s not alone...
summary: Help Shutterspeed escape cyberspace in a race against time to stop the evil AI Heatbones from taking over the world! Original camera powers, exciting set-pieces and unique boss encounters are the order of the day in this story-driven platforming adventure!
